purpose: First production briefs for finished, save-worthy Voice-free Beta content. These are not inventory rows; they are new production targets.

qualityBar.mustFeelLike: finished content with a clear title, scene, structure, and replay reason
qualityBar.mustNotFeelLike: raw white noise, a mixer demo, a machine QA clip, or an unnamed variant
qualityBar.claims: No medical, therapeutic, cure, frequency-effect, or guaranteed-outcome claims.

briefs.title: Quiet Room Cocoon
briefs.structure: soft room tone base, low brown-noise support, barely moving warmth, no foreground events
briefs.replayReason: A safe default for users who dislike rain, birds, music, and obvious loops.

briefs.title: Soft Brown Night
briefs.structure: brown-noise bed with slow low-frequency contour and faint room air
briefs.replayReason: For users who want noise, but not harsh white-noise hiss.

briefs.title: Warm Fan Sleep
briefs.structure: steady fan motor, softened airflow, low-room support, no cyclic wobble
briefs.replayReason: A familiar fan-like sleep bed with less mechanical harshness.

briefs.title: Rainless Dark Room
briefs.structure: quiet room and distant low air only; deliberately excludes water and nature events
briefs.replayReason: A bedtime option for users who find rain or water distracting.

briefs.title: Low Wind Shelter
briefs.structure: muffled low wind outside, protected indoor base, no gust spikes
briefs.audibleIdentity: being indoors while weather stays far away
briefs.replayReason: Gives atmosphere without becoming dramatic or cold.

briefs.title: Return-to-Sleep Cabin
briefs.structure: immediate stable low bed, no intro, no decorative events, gradual softening after 12 minutes
briefs.replayReason: Designed for waking at night when the user does not want novelty.
ingredientsNeeded: aircraft or train low cabin bed

briefs.title: No-Water Bedtime Pad
briefs.structure: very slow harmonic pad under dry room and soft brown bed
briefs.replayReason: For users who want gentle beauty but cannot use water ambience.

briefs.title: Late-Night Apartment Tone
briefs.structure: small room base, distant exterior hush, stable low support
briefs.audibleIdentity: real apartment night without narrative events
briefs.replayReason: Feels less synthetic than generated noise while remaining uneventful.

briefs.title: Gentle Train Night
briefs.structure: low rail movement, softened rhythmic texture, brown-noise stabilizer
briefs.audibleIdentity: sleeping inside a quiet moving carriage
briefs.replayReason: A recognizable environment that can replace generic noise.

briefs.title: Deep Blanket Noise
briefs.structure: deep broadband bed with dark tilt, no room identity, no events
briefs.replayReason: For high-sensitivity users who just need dependable masking.

briefs.title: Warm Breathing Space
briefs.structure: warm pad, spacious room tail, very soft one-shot bell at section changes
briefs.replayReason: Feels intentionally meditative without requiring voice guidance.

briefs.title: Grounded Ambient Pad
briefs.structure: low harmonic anchor, slow mid pad, quiet air, gentle midpoint lift
briefs.replayReason: A calm track that sounds like music, not masked noise.

briefs.title: Forest Edge Stillness
briefs.structure: distant forest bed, low event density, warm pad below nature identity
briefs.audibleIdentity: standing at the edge of a quiet forest
briefs.replayReason: Nature with atmosphere, not random birds and insects.

briefs.title: Soft Bell Exhale
briefs.structure: soft air and pad with sparse bowl/bell one-shots every few minutes
briefs.audibleIdentity: clear exhale cues in spacious calm
briefs.replayReason: A short reset that has structure without spoken instruction.

briefs.title: Open Room Meditation
briefs.structure: open indoor space, low pad, slow stereo air movement
briefs.replayReason: Feels like a designed meditation room rather than a sound effect.

briefs.title: Gentle Guitar Horizon
briefs.structure: soft guitar texture, low pad support, no lead-song structure
briefs.replayReason: A more musical calm option for users bored by pure ambience.

briefs.title: Low Piano Reflection
briefs.structure: sparse low piano gestures, warm pad tail, long gaps
briefs.replayReason: Provides an emotionally legible alternative to abstract pads.

briefs.title: Floating Evening Calm
briefs.structure: gentle harmonic bed, faint outdoor dusk tone, slow softening over time
briefs.audibleIdentity: evening transition from alert to quiet
briefs.replayReason: A bridge between focus and sleep without becoming sleepy immediately.

briefs.title: Slow Body Scan Bed
briefs.structure: subtle section changes every 4 minutes, soft bell cues, steady warmth
briefs.replayReason: Can later support voice, but already works as a voice-free practice bed.

briefs.title: Quiet After-Work Reset
briefs.structure: neutral room, low pad, slight opening over final third
briefs.replayReason: A practical daily-use calm track, not only bedtime content.

briefs.title: Quiet Train Focus
briefs.structure: steady train carriage, low masking bed, no station events
briefs.replayReason: Recognizable but not distracting, useful for work sessions.

briefs.title: Neutral Office Flow
briefs.structure: neutral office room tone, restrained fan layer, very low pad support
briefs.replayReason: Creates a working atmosphere without keyboard/coworker distractions.

briefs.title: Cabin Noise Workspace
briefs.structure: aircraft cabin rumble, soft pink noise, slight mid clarity
briefs.replayReason: Useful for users who need stronger distraction masking.

briefs.title: Low Anchor Pad
briefs.structure: low harmonic anchor, clear but unobtrusive mid pad, quiet noise floor
briefs.replayReason: Gives focus a musical identity distinct from sleep noise.

briefs.title: Warm Mechanical Focus
briefs.structure: warm machine bed, low event density, mild harmonic support
briefs.replayReason: For people who focus better with machinery-like continuity.

briefs.title: Distant Traffic Shield
briefs.structure: diffuse traffic wash, softened transients, low pink support
briefs.replayReason: Masks urban distraction with a controlled urban texture.

briefs.title: Clean Pink Focus
briefs.structure: premium pink noise with subtle movement and no sleep-dark tilt
briefs.replayReason: A minimal focus option that is less harsh than basic white noise.

briefs.title: Soft Air Conditioner Flow
briefs.structure: air conditioner flow, smoothed mechanical tone, no rattles
briefs.replayReason: A simple but productized mechanical focus bed.

briefs.title: Workroom Steady State
briefs.structure: dry room tone, low mechanical base, neutral pad enters after 3 minutes
briefs.replayReason: Feels like being in a dedicated work space.

briefs.title: Open Air Concentration
briefs.structure: open air texture, restrained warm pad, light masking bed
briefs.replayReason: A less claustrophobic focus option for daytime use.
